```{r}
library('ggplot2')
library('dplyr')
data <- vroom::vroom("BirthWeights.txt")
```

# 1. 

```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(x=Mage, y=BirthWeight)) + 
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method="lm", se=FALSE)
```


# 2. 

```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(x=Race, y=BirthWeight)) + 
  geom_boxplot()
```


# 3. 

```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(x = Gage, y = BirthWeight, color = Race)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) + 
  labs(x = 'Gestational Age', y = "Weight at Birth (g)")
```

# 4. 

```{r}
data %>%
  group_by(Gen) %>%
  summarise(correlation = cor(BirthWeight, Mage))
```


# 5. 

```{r}
GGally::ggpairs(data)
```
